title: Ornot Special Projects: Short Sleeve Micro Grid Jersey and Micro Climate Vest
content:
Continuing in the pursuit of making limited-edition silhouettes from deadstock fabrics, Ornot just rolled out its long-awaited Micro Grid Jersey ($165) and a Micro Climate Vest ($158)…

 

Micro Grid Jersey

The Micro Grid Jersey is made in the USA from lightweight Polartec Power Grid, this short-sleeve jersey is designed to keep you cool down to the 50º range when paired with a lightweight jacket or vest, while the highly breathable fabric performs on its own up into the 80º range.

Typically, the brushed grid structure used in this jersey is associated with thermal clothing, but this version is light enough for summer temps. The small voids created by the grid, along with the fine knit, let air pass through. This keeps you cool when it’s hot. On the flip side, when you add a wind-blocking layer, those same air pockets keep you warm while wicking moisture away from your skin. It’s like magic (or just physics).

This jersey is made entirely from deadstock fabric and built right here in Oakland, California. Available in both men’s and women’s variants with a new, updated fit, this could be your only jersey, Ornot.

Specs:

  • Extremely wicking and breathable.
  • Anti-Microbial Treatment.
  • bluesign®-approved Polartec deadstock fabric.
  • Temperature range: 55-85 degrees, perfect for layering.
  • 3 rear pockets, YKK zipper, reflective details.
  • Sewn by hand in California.
  • MSRP: $165 USD

Micro Climate Vest

The Micro Climate Vest is Ornot’s ultimate choice for breathable warmth. Based on its award-winning Micro Climate Jacket, this vest features a flocked front and a lightweight grid fleece back for an ideal balance of insulation and breathability. For this season, Ornot brought back 3 rear pockets, added reflective details, and wrapped it up with a 2-way zipper.

Available in both men’s and women’s variants, you could call it a Gilet, Ornot. Made in Oakland, CA.

Specs:

  • 3 rear pockets.
  • Water-resistant and quick-drying due to patented thread treatment on the front panel.
  • 2-way YKK zipper for venting and pocket access.
  • 125 grams (size small) – Temp range: 40 – 67 degrees.
  • Reflective details on shoulder and back.
  • Breathable Polartec grid fleece on back and neck interior.
  • Sewn by hand in California.
  • Made using OEKO-TEX and bluesign®-approved fabric.
  • Men’s and Women’s Variants
  • MSRP: $158 USD

See more at Ornot.
